question: In June 2023, which state Government launched a project named ‘Pride’ to provide employment opportunities to the transgender community in diverse and innovative sectors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In June 2023, the **Kerala government launched a project named 'Pride'** to provide employment opportunities to the transgender community.
 
• The initiative aims to employ transgender individuals in diverse sectors, including **modern, innovative, and inclusive workspaces**.
 
• The project is part of Kerala's efforts to promote **social inclusion and economic empowerment** of transgender individuals.
 
• Kerala has been a progressive state in ensuring the rights and welfare of the transgender community, introducing several schemes and programs for their upliftment.
 
• The state has also set up a **Transgender Justice Board** to address the issues faced by the community and ensure their integration into mainstream society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019**

 
 
• This Act provides a comprehensive framework for the protection of the rights of transgender persons in India.
 
• It prohibits discrimination against transgender individuals in education, employment, healthcare, and access to public services.
 
• Under this Act, transgender persons have the right to self-identify their gender.
 
• The Act mandates the establishment of welfare boards and schemes for the development and empowerment of transgender individuals.
 
 
 
• **Kerala's Transgender Policy (2015)**
 
 
• Kerala became the first Indian state to implement a transgender policy aimed at improving the lives of transgender individuals.
 
• The policy focuses on providing equal rights, opportunities, and access to resources for the transgender community.
 
• It includes measures such as skill development programs, healthcare support, and anti-discrimination initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Transgender Welfare Schemes in Kerala**
 
 
• Kerala has introduced various welfare schemes, including housing projects, vocational training programs, and self-employment initiatives for transgender individuals.
 
• The state has also launched exclusive transgender clinics to ensure access to healthcare services.
 
 
 
• **Social Inclusion of Transgender Community**
 
 
• Governments and NGOs across India are working on promoting social inclusion and reducing stigma against the transgender community.
 
• Employment programs, awareness campaigns, and educational initiatives are key strategies to integrate transgender individuals into mainstream society.
